description: Explicit canonical-role -> source-bone map for the uploaded Mixamo rig (65 bones). The rig contains Spine/Spine1/Spine2 and finger chains, which the generic alias matcher reports as ambiguous (chest, left_hand, right_hand, toes). This map resolves the ambiguity deterministically instead of letting the pipeline guess. Fingers are intentionally not mapped: the game targets have no finger joints, so finger motion is dropped and reported.

source_skeleton.evidence: All 74 uploaded FBX files carry the same 65 bone names and the same parent links. Rest-pose bone lengths split them into two proportional variants (skeleton groups skel_226dc3817c: 19 files, skel_534eaa02b3: 55 files, e.g. the LeftFoot offset is 0.4453 m vs 0.3824 m). The role map is name based, so it applies to both variants; each file is grouped separately in docs/animation-library/inventory.json.

limitations: The uploads contain two proportional variants of the same naming scheme; grouping is per file, so a clip is never assumed compatible with another clip's rig without a matching fingerprint.

The uploaded rig rest pose is a T-pose with the arms along +X; the game targets use the same T-pose, but pelvis yaw differs per clip, so the retarget reproduces the source's absolute orientation rather than normalising the facing.
Finger and eye bones are not present on the targets and their motion is not exported.
Root motion is retargeted only for the hips joint (the only translated bone in the sources).
